title: Re-plug the iPhone's USB cable
instructions: The Mac lost the iPhone on USB (the cable is in, but the phone tools cannot reach it). Unplug the cable from the iPhone, wait 3 s, plug it back in, unlock the phone, then press Done. This step closes by itself when the link is back.

history.note: Not needed now: no phone test is planned for the next ~90 min (the original-behaviour work runs in Chrome and the Simulator). Plug the phone back in whenever convenient.
